clips.title: The story
paras: Volcor lies wounded in Blackwood Den, deep in southern Darkshore. The night elf scout depends on his bear Grimclaw and Auberdine's defenders to escape the hostile furbolgs.

Volcor is a night elf scout wounded inside Blackwood Den. While tracking the corrupted Blackwood tribe through its underground lair, he was ambushed and badly hurt. He could not fight past the hostile furbolgs alone, so he sent Grimclaw, his loyal bear companion, into the wilds of Darkshore to seek help in Auberdine.
